ops.text: Repo hooks bind to the session's checkout: CliState.hooks_dir resolves $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks, fixed at session start, so a long-lived session on a stale branch keeps running stale hooks after a fix lands on trunk. Oct 5: the monorepo long-running root sat in worktree sole on yasyf/retro-link-hook, 103 commits behind dev with a local draft of slack_writes_need_permission.py; #30705 (board approvals) landed at 1:50 PM, but a Slack lane the root spawned at 4:4x PM was still blocked posting the board-approved Polar AML note. Fixed by hand by moving sole onto dev. Candidate fix: guard hooks resolve from the trunk checkout (git common dir) or a trunk snapshot rather than the session branch, with branch-local hooks reserved for capt-hook test.
